scope: Plugin channel-only MIDI CC120 and ordered editor global panic. Native SDK, Web/Tauri/npm, version/tag/release, installed AU and GarageBand were not changed.

specification.cc120: Mute held, pedal-held and releasing voices of the addressed MIDI channel using volume zero and KOFF; stop both physical voices of a PMON pair. Invalid and empty channels do nothing.
specification.history_limit: Dry stops immediately at the MIDI offset at 44100 Hz. Other host rates retain the existing mixed history for approximately two native sample intervals; no global history reset.
specification.fresh_note: Stopped physical voices are marked fresh; a subsequent NoteOn reloads source state without replaying old release/audition restart.
specification.editor_all_sound_off: Still global: clears all voices and shared effect tail. UI MIDI and stop share one ordered fixed-capacity FIFO so pre-stop queued notes cannot replay; post-stop fresh notes can play.
specification.ui_queue_threading: Single editor producer / single audio consumer with lock-free size_t and bool atomics; bounded snapshot drain; overflow discards pending UI input and invokes existing global controller/voice recovery.
specification.ui_lifecycle: Reset, deactivate, bypass cleanup and successful quiescent state restore discard pending UI input. Failed restore preserves it. Zero-frame blocks do not advance UI commands.
specification.host_contract: Existing serialized host MIDI ingress and quiescent lifecycle state restore contract retained.

checks: ordinary and aligned C++ new/delete zero in RT interval

ui_queue.unit: FIFO including panic/fresh order, all 1024 slots, overflow/reset/array wraps, deterministic producer-after-consumer-snapshot, two-thread 100000 exact commands, ordinary/aligned new/delete zero
